[p3r514n] HN are muppets. It's True RGB, not True 4K RGB. It's basically their buzzword for having three completely native, independent micro-diodes for RGB. Other Mini RGB panels typically use blue diodes with red phosphors. Just to confuse you even more, Samsung have Micro RGB which are smaller than 100 microns whereas Mini RGB is between 100 to 400 microns. Naturally, the smaller the better as you can fit more in.
[MrZ] Shame it's LCD. That's a lot of coin for a LCD.
